row.name: Nicolet Bankshares Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=24 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.32 tightness=0.81 base_volume_vs_leg=0.46 base_volume_vs_avg=0.82
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 24 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -1.4% vs its 20-SMA, -2.1% over 20 sessions

claude.reason: The shaded base spans roughly 24 sessions and is visibly a sideways-to-declining range from the August peak, with multiple wide overlapping red and green bars and no tightening — this is a consolidation that looks more like distribution than a quiet rest. RE fails outright (burst bar is only 44% of the prior 5-bar range), meaning there is no genuine expansion out of the base. The burst bar itself is a tiny 0.08% close-to-close move on a stock sitting below its August highs with clear overhead supply from the entire base zone.
claude.key_risk: The base is 24 sessions of overlapping, wide bars below a prior high — the structure looks like distribution, not accumulation, and any follow-through is likely to stall into that overhead supply immediately.
claude.entry_note: Skip at the open if price gaps below the burst-day close of 168.02 or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest above 168, confirming the move has no momentum.

row.summary: NIC: +0.1% on 2.5× volume out of a base 8.6% deep. skip 9.0, 5 of 6 criteria.
